It is apparent that Mormon did not mean literally that their writing system did not permit addressing whole subjects, considering how many topics are in fact treated in the Book of Mormon.Ether 12:25no doubt clarifies his meaning; Moroni there makes the point that they stumble “because of the placing of our words.” That was “the imperfection” they suffered in their writing. (SeeMorm. 9:31.) Ambiguities imposed by using a glyphic system instead of an alphabetic system would accounnt for the difficulty. (CompareMorm. 9:33.)
